I want to see the average rating of shows and movies that have the word murder in their description, these could be horrors, thrillers, mystery etc.

Make graph of this, use string extract all to find murder
```{r}
netflix_titles <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2021/2021-04-20/netflix_titles.csv')
netflix_titles <- netflix_titles|>
  mutate(rating_fct = fct_relevel(factor(rating),  "G", "TV-Y", "TV-G", "TV-Y7", "TV-Y7-FV",
"PG", "TV-PG", "PG-13", "TV-14",
"R", "TV-MA", "NC-17"))
murder <- netflix_titles|>
  filter(str_detect(description, regex("murder|\\bkill(ed)?\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)))
```


```{r}
murder|>
  ggplot(aes(y = rating_fct))+
  geom_bar(fill = "#B0CCFF")+
  facet_wrap(~type, scales = "free_x")+
  labs(title = "Netflix Media with Murder", x = "Number", y = "Rating")+
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica Neue")+
theme_light()+
theme(
  text = element_text(size = 14, color = "#263D69")
)+
theme(
  strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#263D69", color = NA),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "#FFEBE8")
)
```

Rom com exploration
```{r}
comedies <- netflix_titles|>
  filter(type == "Movie", str_detect(country, "United States"),
    str_detect(listed_in, "Comedies"))

 
 actors <- c(
  "Adam Sandler",
  "Jim Carrey",
  "Will Ferrell",
  "Ben Stiller",
  "Eddie Murphy",
  "Steve Carell",
  "Seth Rogen",
  "Jonah Hill",
  "Paul Rudd",
  "Kevin Hart",
  "Jack Black",
  "Melissa McCarthy",
  "Kristen Wiig",
  "Tina Fey",
  "Amy Poehler",
  "Maya Rudolph",
  "Tiffany Haddish",
  "Jennifer Aniston",
  "Sandra Bullock",
  "Julia Roberts"
)
comedies <- comedies |>
  mutate(
    famous_actor = str_detect(
      cast, "\\b(Adam Sandler|Jim Carrey|Will Ferrell|Ben Stiller|Eddie Murphy|Steve Carell|Seth Rogen|Jonah Hill|Paul Rudd|Kevin Hart|Jack Black|Melissa McCarthy|Kristen Wiig|Tina Fey|Amy Poehler|Maya Rudolph|Tiffany Haddish|Jennifer Aniston|Sandra Bullock|Julia Roberts)(?=,|$)"
      ))|>
   mutate( decade = floor(release_year / 10) * 10)
    
  
  comedies |>
  ggplot(aes(x = decade, fill = famous_actor)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "#263D69", "FALSE" = "#B0CCFF"),
    labels = c("FALSE" = "No", "TRUE" = "Yes"),
    name = "Contains Famous Comedy Actor"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "American Comedies by Release Year",
    x = "Decade",
    y = "Number of Movies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica Neue")

```
